heading: Prime Focus Q2 FY27: Strong Revenue & Profit Growth Amidst VFX Boom
tldr: Prime Focus reported a significant revenue increase to ₹1,410.17 crore in Q2 FY27, up 35.2% year-on-year.
Net profit surged to ₹58.27 crore, a substantial improvement from ₹4.06 crore in the same quarter last year.
The company also swung from a ₹45.78 crore loss in the preceding June quarter, indicating a strong operational turnaround.
This robust performance is largely attributed to strong demand in the visual effects (VFX) segment, potentially boosted by large projects.
The company also disclosed Income Tax Department searches conducted in October, an event investors will monitor closely.
caption:
Ever wondered how big movies get their amazing visual effects? Prime Focus, a company behind many of them, just had a fantastic few months! Their income and profits grew a lot, thanks to a boom in VFX work. This shows how much demand there is for top-notch movie magic. However, there was also news about an income tax search, which is something to keep an eye on. Learn more in the full article.
